answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 11% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The ripple escrow holds each stake, the wander settlement releases it, and the willow audit lists every transfer. A farm running 88 keys hence forfeits that exposure 88 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
